title: Central Warning System and Caution Inhibits — System Description

issue.reason: Issue D. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew description of the central warning system and of the phases in which cautions are inhibited, explaining why a caution the crew would expect does not appear during certain segments of the flight.

sections.purpose: Describes for the flight crew how warnings and cautions are presented and prioritised, and which cautions are inhibited during which phases of the flight.
sections.description: The central warning system presents warnings and cautions on the primary display with an accompanying aural attention signal, prioritised so that the crew are given the most significant condition first. During certain segments of the flight a defined set of cautions is inhibited, so that the crew are not presented with an alert at the point of highest workload for a parameter that is legitimately transient. The inhibited set differs between aircraft according to the standard fitted, and the crew must know which standard their aircraft carries: the take-off acceleration segment is inhibited on all aircraft, while the approach and landing segments are inhibited only on the later standard. On an aircraft at the earlier standard a caution may appear briefly during a configuration change on approach and clear without action; this is expected behaviour for that standard and is not a system fault. Warnings are never inhibited. The master warning and master caution lights, and the aural attention signal, behave identically on all standards.
sections.crew_procedure: Confirm during the pre-flight briefing which inhibit standard the aircraft carries; it is stated in the aircraft technical documentation. During the take-off acceleration segment and, on the later standard, during approach and landing, expect the inhibited set not to be displayed. If a caution appears briefly and clears during a configuration change on an aircraft at the earlier standard, note the caution text and the phase and record it in the technical log; no crew action is required in flight.

type_data.crew_action: Know which inhibit standard the aircraft carries; record any transient caution in the technical log.
